name: c-noti
description: Keep pull requests small: measure branch diff size against a base branch and warn before it grows too big.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/cli.js && cp dist/cli.js plugin/bin/c-noti.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
